name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Dasari's distance is immediately next to the colonist from Callisto.
The colonist studying Basalt's distance is at least 4 ly more than Anders.
Anders' distance is immediately next to the colonist from Ganymede.
Anders' distance is lower than both the colonist from Callisto and the colonist studying Plankton.
